rulings.decision: A bare integer with no time unit is invalid input and must throw.
rulings.rationale: a bare number with no unit is invalid — the intent says 'duration string' implying a unit is required; '120' is ambiguous seconds vs minutes vs anything

rulings.decision: A duration string with leading or trailing whitespace and internal spaces between components must be accepted; the result is the sum of the component values in seconds.
rulings.rationale: leading/trailing whitespace and internal spaces are accepted; the function should trim and normalize — '1h30m' = 5400s

rulings.decision: A fractional quantity before a unit is accepted and scaled by that unit; the result is the total seconds for that fractional amount.
When the same unit appears more than once, the quantities for that unit are summed.
rulings.rationale: repeated units are additive (ordering ruling, rev 3)

rulings.decision: Units may appear in any order; the total is the sum of all unit quantities regardless of the order they are written.
